name: Ambroxol
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 30 mg three times daily for 2 to 3 days, then 30 mg twice daily; may increase to 60 mg twice daily
Up to 6 lozenges (20 mg) a day for no more than 3 days

common: Altered taste, oral and throat numbness (lozenges)
serious: Severe skin reactions: erythema multiforme, Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis

monitoring: Skin reactions; stop if progressive rash

pk.peak: 1 to 2.5 hours (immediate release); about 6.5 hours (slow release)
pk.half_life_eskd: Not quantified; liver metabolites expected to accumulate
pk.metabolism: Hepatic glucuronidation; CYP3A4 forms dibromanthranilic acid (about 10%)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Renal clearance about 8% of total clearance; about 83% of a dose recovered in urine over 5 days, mostly as metabolites (26% conjugated); under 10% unchanged
